name: rosetta-jortsort
code:
use default

jort_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: T[]) -> bool is
    let sorted = LIST(values)

    sorted.sort()

    (0..values.count) |> all(index => sorted[index] =~ values[index])
si

report[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: T[]) is
    let shown = values |> map(value => "{value}") |> join(" ")

    let answer = if jort_sort(values) then "true" else "false" fi

    write_line("[{shown}] was already sorted: {answer}")
si

report([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
report([1, 3, 2, 4, 5])
report(["alpha", "beta", "gamma"])
report(["gamma", "beta", "alpha"])
